purpose: isolated feasibility test of highlight supervision aligned with the declared ACES view
training: 600 fresh-Adam updates at 0.0001, seed 20261024, batch4 crop192. Cache full-frame frozen predictor features and restored AP1. Train only final three radiance-output head channels; all other weights including source correction channels frozen. Equal eligible-scene sampling, then image and highlight location. Signed asinh RGB error only on highlight support; exclude one-pixel artificial head boundary.
acceptance: all frozen weights bit-exact; no nonfinite values
original five natural development gates still pass; explicitly report change versus v7
on new scene-disjoint exact-view development set, highlight MSE at least 5% better than v7 and no worse than analytic
partial-highlight appearance within one code on at least 99.9% of evaluated pixels
ordinary and shadow outputs unchanged outside highlight support
motion, colour stress, detail and grading checks required separately before any promotion
limits: Small development experiment with previously used CC0 scenes; not independent release validation. Does not replace existing benchmark or relax product requirements.
encoding_correction: Rerun with corrected canonical PNG encoding, loader read-back checks, source-support identity and cached-head initial-output parity. All earlier misencoded-data trials are invalid.
